name: Approve Form
summary: Publishes a form's current draft as the live (approved) version.
whenToUse: After editing a form's draft, to make the changes live.
confirm: Approving publishes the current draft as the live version — it replaces the previously approved version. Continue?
notes: Only a form that has a draft can be approved.
Marketo docs: 'Approving a form replaces the existing approved version, if any, with the current draft.'
